actions.label: Title
Arrived in Mother Goose Land
Watered Mary's contrary garden
The mouse ran up the clock
Humpty Dumpty climbed back up
Jack Sprat and his wife licked the platter clean
Rode a cock-horse to Banbury Cross
Bo-Peep found her sheep
Peter kept his wife in a pumpkin shell
The little dog came home
Jack jumped over the candlestick
Mary's lamb followed her to school
Little Jack Horner pulled out a plum
The crooked man found his crooked sixpence
Tommy Tucker cut his bread
Jack and Jill fetched their pail of water
Miss Muffet sat on her tuffet
The old woman in the shoe fed her children broth
The cat played the fiddle and the cow jumped over the moon
Old King Cole got his pipe
Old King Cole called for his fiddlers three
Mother Goose Land said goodbye
Woke up at home to Mother Goose's congratulations
